definition: The history of natural language processing describes the advances of natural language processing.
details: There is some overlap with the history of machine translation, the history of speech recognition, and the history of artificial intelligence.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. Boil it down and it is this: The history of natural language processing describes the advances of natural language processing. Here is why it matters: There is some overlap with the history of machine translation, the history of speech recognition, and the history of artificial intelligence. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. That pattern-earned fluency is History of natural language processing.
